layer_gaps.observation: Zero public and zero private companies; ASML, KLA, Synopsys and Cadence are the obvious incumbents absent from this dataset entirely.
Zero primary assignments despite massive activity; hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) dominate but sit in Enterprise theme, leaving this layer without a pure-play public name.
Private-only at primary layer (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI all pre-IPO); largest AI capex allocators are entirely inaccessible to public-market investors as pure plays.
Zero public primaries; CoreWeave (recently IPO'd) and Vantage are the only names, making hyperscale datacenter operation effectively a private-only layer for new investment.
Four private SMR/next-gen nuclear startups versus only GEV as public incumbent; SMR commercialization wave has no investable pure-play public equity yet.
Zero public primaries despite growing loitering munitions demand; Epirus and Castelion are private-only, leaving the counter-drone and hypersonics wave untracked publicly.
Zero public and zero private primary assignments; ISR satellites and space surveillance are covered only as secondary layers of LMT/IRDM, a structural gap for investors.
Zero public primaries; K2 Space and Apex Space are pure-play private bus manufacturers, while SpaceX manufactures Starlink satellites internally at scale.
Zero public and zero private primaries; covered only as secondary layers — an overlooked infrastructure layer given rising constellation count.
Crowded with six private challengers (Figure, Apptronik, 1X, Agility, Neura, Unitree) and zero public primaries; largest near-term robotics growth vector is entirely private.
Zero public and zero private primaries; harmonic drives, servo motors and actuators (e.g., Harmonic Drive AG) are not represented, a deep supply-chain gap.
Zero public primaries; Physical Intelligence and Skild AI are private-only, meaning the robot-brain software layer has no public investable proxy.
Zero public primaries; Socket, Abnormal AI and Zenity are private challengers competing in CNAPP/data-security without a dedicated public pure-play.
Zero public primaries; Torq, Zafran and Eye Security are private-only, while CRWD, S and PANW cover it only as secondary layers.
Zero public and only one private (XBOW); AI-driven offensive security / red-teaming is nascent with almost no investable exposure.
Crowded with four public primaries (PANW, FTNT, NET, ZS) and zero private challengers at primary layer; incumbents appear entrenched with no notable new entrant.
Crowded with seven private challengers vs. only two public names (RXRX, SDGR); Discovery Platforms is the most contested private biotech layer and may see consolidation.
Zero public and zero private primaries; clinical-stage pure plays are spread across hundreds of small-cap biotechs outside this dataset entirely.
Zero public and zero private primaries at this layer; covered only as secondary for RXRX/SDGR, a gap given translational AI is a distinct investable category.
Zero public primaries with only Redwood Materials as a private player; battery recycling mandates are growing but have no public pure-play investment vehicle.
Zero public primaries; Base Power is the only private name, while FLNC covers it as secondary — a gap given utility-scale BESS deployment is accelerating rapidly.
Zero public primaries; Revolut is the dominant private player while Unit and Marqeta (outside dataset) are the only names, suggesting BaaS is under-represented publicly.
Zero public primaries despite the AML/KYC compliance software market growing rapidly; Ramp covers it as primary but is private, and no public pure-play exists.
Zero public primaries; Cognition (Devin) is the only private primary, while MSFT/GOOGL and NOW/CRM own it as secondary — the emergent agentic layer has no public pure-play.
Zero public primaries; OpenAI, Anthropic and Cohere are all private, making the most strategically critical AI layer entirely inaccessible as a direct public-market investment.
